'''2009 Bespin Regionals Mark Walseth LS Dagobah''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah (Light)|Dagobah-L-dagobah.gif|label=Dagobah}}
* '''Deck name:''' Fun but Lame
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
